G4_detour_sites.planner: r3 (waypoint on an equal cut, pinned by its repeater)

P_asbuilt.band: TT mean 250 +- 20 (rise/fall-average model), TT window <= 20, FF EARLY window <= 20

provenance.note: re-run = provenance.argv from provenance.cwd; every input listed with its sha256

entry_trunk.objective: min over chains of max(|TT-250|, |FF-202.5|) (predicted means)
entry_trunk.rule: 12.8c designed fixed trunk at the entry, same chain every instance, computed from plan geometry + NLDM before build (12.8 d1); no measured input
entry_trunk.run: N-S in the centre gap from the entry island
entry_trunk.note: first-order: trunk delay added to the as-built leaf arrivals (same chain every leaf)
